## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow conventional format (`type(scope): subject (#issue)`)

- [ ] No hardcoded values (URLs, tokens, IPs)
- [ ] No secrets committed (`.env`, keys, tokens)
- [ ] No debug statements left behind
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Branch name follows convention (`feature/`, `fix/`, `hotfix/`)
